subject: a simple thing we should do

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: a simple thing we should do
parts:
Or maybe it's on the agenda already…

The next release will have Stan-optimize, right? In addition, we should have an option for it to spit out the covariance matrix (computed based on curvature at the mode) and an option to spit out draws from the normal approximation. Then it could be a direct replacement for lm, glm, mle, etc.

A
